title: MatFormer nested speculative drafter with Mirror granularity view
hypothesis: A small Mirror coordinate on a narrow nested drafter improves its distributional alignment with the full shared verifier enough to increase exact speculative-decoding throughput, while using fewer complete bytes than an independently parameterized drafter/verifier pair.
physical_object: One frozen width-16 MLP supermodel. Width-8 and width-12 nested children use prefixes of the same hidden layer and output matrix.
mirror_coordinate: Four learned Givens angles rotate pairs of width-8 draft hidden activations before the shared output projection. The verifier remains the unmodified width-16 model.
logical_multiplicity: One physical supermodel provides width-8 draft, width-12 nested reference and width-16 verifier roles; the Mirror code changes only the width-8 draft role.
prior_art_delta: PA53 MatFormer already provides nested child models; PA15 uses a routed slim verifier for hierarchical verification. This screen tests a tiny role-specific Mirror correction to the nested draft distribution, with width-12 as a stronger nested compute reference and full-width exact verifier. It does not claim to reproduce PA15's routed rejection hierarchy.

methods: shared nested width-8 draft without view
shared width-8 draft plus four Mirror angles
shared width-8 draft plus FiLM scale/shift
independent width-8 draft alongside full verifier

teacher_and_task.teacher: A seeded frozen width-16 tanh MLP defines next-token distributions over 16 classes for Gaussian contexts. Width-8/12 logits are prefix subnetworks from the same supermodel.
teacher_and_task.adaptation: Mirror angles, FiLM parameters and independent width-8 weights are fitted to the full teacher softmax on training contexts only; the full verifier and shared supermodel stay frozen.
teacher_and_task.speculative_metric: For each held-out context, report draft/full overlap sum_v min(q(v),p(v)) as expected one-token acceptance. Then construct the standard exact residual-corrected speculative output distribution and report its max deviation from p_full.
teacher_and_task.latency_metric: Measure draft and full-verifier CPU forward times separately and calculate expected emitted tokens per cycle divided by draft-plus-verifier time; compare with full-only token throughput. Also report measured draft tokens/s.

controls: nested width-12 draft as higher-compute shared reference
FiLM correction on width-8 draft hidden state
independent width-8 draft trained against the same teacher
full width-16 verifier as exact quality/runtime reference

development.selection_metric: Held-out draft/full overlap and expected exact speculative tokens/s are primary; corrected-distribution exactness, draft KL/NLL, actual payload bytes, training cost and latency are required.
development.allowed_tuning: No tuning planned. Fixed teacher, widths, data sizes, update schedule and optimizer. Correctness fixes may rerun development before fresh access.

fresh.open_gate: Both development worlds: corrected speculative output max absolute distribution error <=1e-6; Mirror held-out overlap improves over nested width-8 by >=0.05 and is within 0.03 of width-12; expected exact speculative tokens/s >=1.05x full-only; Mirror complete payload <=0.80x independent-pair payload; Mirror training wall time <=1.5x FiLM; exact payload replay. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
fresh.fresh_success: All three fresh worlds satisfy acceptance, exactness, measured throughput, training cost, bytes and replay gates.

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: Mirror angles or FiLM correction parameters, when used
full independent width-8 drafter weights in the independent control
model widths, activation/decoder metadata and archive overhead
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Nested width slices are exact prefixes of the paid supermodel; no second copy of shared weights is stored.

success_gate: All fresh acceptance, exactness, actual-payload, expected-throughput, training-cost and replay criteria pass.
failure_gate: A frozen development acceptance, throughput, training-cost, storage or exactness gate fails.
boundaries: one-step synthetic next-token distributions, not autoregressive language generation
teacher is a frozen small MLP and no GPU is required
exactness applies to residual-corrected one-token speculative sampling against the full verifier
fixed update budget is not a capacity or language-model result
PA15 hierarchical routed verification is cited but not implemented in this screen
